description: The plot illustrates the change in BLEU score across epochs for three different member sets. The x-axis represents “Epochs” on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. The y-axis represents “BLEU score” on a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.35 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. A blue solid line, labeled “Regular members”, begins at approximately 0.03 at an epoch of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.12 at an epoch of 3.0, with a relatively steady increase between epochs 0.5 and 2.5. An orange solid line, labeled “Members with near-duplicates”, starts at approximately 0.04 at an epoch of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.32 at an epoch of 3.0, with a rapid increase between epochs 0.5 and 1.5, followed by a more gradual increase. A green solid line, labeled “Held-out data”, begins at approximately 0.02 at an epoch of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.07 at an epoch of 3.0, with a slight decline between epochs 1.5 and 2.0.
